ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity black pixels (approx. 90%) with localized high-intensity white/beige clusters at distal tips and distributed white annular marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region with discrete, high-contrast white circular and semi-circular rings (rosettes) concentrated in the medial-left and distal-right regions; distal tips contain dense, irregularly shaped white/beige clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and vertical depth extending into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel-level amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; most pronounced along the medial trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in acute, upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of white annular rings across both lobes, with a specific cluster of approximately 10-12 rings on the left lobe and 5-7 on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonies on the distal tips of both lobes; widespread depigmentation in the form of circular scars indicating previous parasite or barnacle attachment sites.
